evidence: MITgcm at lunar gravity with cells of the patch's size round one river's mouth inside the coarse sea, started at rest from the coarse run's water and run under the same repeated model year of fluxes with a steady river. No tide; closure constants fitted on Earth. Not validated against any observation.
reading_rule: each interval is a mean over a twelfth of the forcing's year (a day in a smoke run). Areas (km2) are the top 5 m by salinity class in g/kg, volumes (km3) all depths, both within the patch's box. Bands give the water by its way over water from the mouth of the Moscoviense route; fresher_water_m is the mean thickness of water under each strength; top_layer_reaches_km the farthest way at which the top layer stands under it. The first months hold the adjustment from a start at rest.
